subject: tunnel mouth
fact: The tunnel mouth opened like a held breath finally released.
source_quote: The tunnel mouth opened like a held breath finally released.

subject: Overbright
fact: The Overbright is a surface environment where light fills everything from every direction at once.
source_quote: The light that came through the tunnel mouth was not like Dawnbringer's light... It was a light that simply *was*, filling everything from every direction at once

subject: Overbright
fact: The Overbright is the surface world beyond the Underdark tunnels.
source_quote: I had been thinking about this moment... The Overbright was a concept I had been carrying through Velkynvelve and Gracklstugh and the Darklake and Blingdenstone

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin emerged first from the tunnel.
source_quote: Thorin first, which was correct — he always led from the front

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf who always leads from the front.
source_quote: Thorin first, which was correct — he always led from the front, always had, it was as close to instinct as that dwarf ever got

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is thinking about Dawnbringer and its exposure to darkness.
source_quote: Thorin, characteristically, was thinking about Dawnbringer. Not what to do with it; he would never give it up, and the sword would never go quietly. But what it had been through. Months of darkness, months of the deep

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin mentioned a specialist called a 'sword whisperer'.
source_quote: He had mentioned something about a specialist — the phrase *sword whisperer* had come up

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum emerged second from the tunnel.
source_quote: Grygum next, blinking with something that looked less like discomfort and more like relief

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum had a genuine spiritual moment with direct sunlight.
source_quote: Grygum next, blinking with something that looked less like discomfort and more like relief, the earnest half-orc having what appeared to be a genuine spiritual moment with direct sunlight

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum opened the bag of holding.
source_quote: Grygum had opened the bag of holding.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum had pamphlets on his mind for Candlekeep.
source_quote: Grygum had pamphlets on his mind. This was entirely consistent. Grygum was the only one among us who had accumulated a list of things he wanted to read

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum planned to look up the lore of Bahamut at Candlekeep.
source_quote: He would look up the lore of Bahamut.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz emerged last from the tunnel.
source_quote: Daz came through last, the way Daz always came through last

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was already observing before he was fully present.
source_quote: Daz came through last, the way Daz always came through last, already observing before he was fully present

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was already composing analysis before his feet cleared the tunnel threshold.
source_quote: Daz came through last, the way Daz always came through last, already composing the analysis before his feet had cleared the threshold

subject: Daz
fact: Daz suspected the group should go to Candlekeep for research.
source_quote: The conclusion — Candlekeep, the Great Library, research into House T'sarran and Jimjar's disappearance and whatever the various cutouts and hired Duskryns were ultimately pointing at regarding Daz's own history — was reasonable.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was likely drafting a journal entry in the Overbright.
source_quote: Daz was, I suspected, already drafting a journal entry.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz possesses the Stonespeaker Crystal.
source_quote: The Stonespeaker Crystal was Daz's.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth emerged from the tunnel as part of the group.
source_quote: The rest of our moltley crew followed, Eldeth, Spiderbait, and the rest of the folks who had survived this journey.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait emerged from the tunnel as part of the group.
source_quote: The rest of our moltley crew followed, Eldeth, Spiderbait, and the rest of the folks who had survived this journey.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is a grey ooze who peered out of the bag of holding.
source_quote: Glabbagool — our companion, our gelatinous ward who was now a grey ooze... had peered out.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool had never been in sunlight before.
source_quote: He had not been in sunlight before.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool survived the Blingdenstone ooze crisis.
source_quote: Glabbagool had survived Blingdenstone, the ooze crisis, the bag of holding, and however many months of Underdark travel

subject: Drow cloak
fact: Drow cloaks disintegrate in sunlight.
source_quote: I knew that Drow cloaks disintegrated in the sunlight.

subject: bag of holding
fact: Grygum opened the bag of holding.
source_quote: Grygum had opened the bag of holding.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a sword that was exposed to months of darkness in the Underdark.
source_quote: Dawnbringer... a blade whose nature was radiance forced to endure the complete absence of the thing it was built to carry.

subject: Stonespeaker Crystal
fact: The Stonespeaker Crystal is possessed by Daz.
source_quote: The Stonespeaker Crystal was Daz's.

subject: Brother Quellin
fact: Brother Quellin taught a class on material impermanence.
source_quote: I think it was Brother Quellin, or possibly the tall one whose name I never quite caught, the one who always had chalk dust on his robe. The transience of tools. The attachment to implements. Something about a bowl and an empty hand.

subject: the tall one
fact: The tall one, whose name the speaker never caught, taught a class on material impermanence.
source_quote: I think it was Brother Quellin, or possibly the tall one whose name I never quite caught, the one who always had chalk dust on his robe. The transience of tools. The attachment to implements. Something about a bowl and an empty hand.

subject: emergence into the Overbright

source_quote: The others emerged around me.

subject: Drow cloaks being stored
fact: The speaker put their Drow cloak in a bag because it disintegrates in sunlight.
source_quote: I put my cloak in a bag. I knew that Drow cloaks disintegrated in the sunlight.

subject: Glabbagool peering out of the bag of holding
fact: Glabbagool peered out of the bag of holding when it was opened.
source_quote: Grygum had opened the bag of holding just enough, and Glabbagool... had peered out.

subject: group standing in the Overbright
fact: The group stood in the Overbright longer than tactically necessary.
